items.name: 细节弯曲(枝3倍频/叶7倍频)
items.src: GPU Gems 3 Ch.16《Vegetation Procedural Animation and Shading in Crysis》(Crytek/NVIDIA, developer.nvidia.com/gpugems/gpugems3/part-iii-rendering/chapter-16-vegetation-procedural-animation-and-shading-crysis)。主弯曲: fBF=vPos.z*fBendScale; fBF+=1; fBF=fBF*fBF-fBF; vNewPos.xy+=vWind.xy*fBF; 再 normalize(vNewPos)*fLength 重缩放。细节弯曲用四个三角波(两边缘+两叶片): TriangleWave(x)=abs(frac(x+0.5)*2-1); SmoothCurve(x)=x*x*(3-2x); SmoothTriangleWave(x)=SmoothCurve(TriangleWave(x)); 频率四元组 (1.975,0.793,0.375,0.193)；相位 fObjPhase=dot(worldPos.xyz,1)→每株不同步
items.search_hint: Crysis vegetation detail bending branch leaf frequency
items.note: CRYENGINE 顶点色 R=叶片边缘刚度 G=每叶相位变化 B=叶片整体刚度 A=预计算 AO（原记成“B=叶片上下”，与原文不符，已按 Ch.16 Figure 16-2 更正）
items.source: GPU Gems 3 Ch.16《Vegetation Procedural Animation and Shading in Crysis》(NVIDIA)。主弯曲: fBF=vPos.z*fBendScale; fBF+=1; fBF=fBF*fBF-fBF; vNewPos.xy+=vWind.xy*fBF; 再 normalize(vNewPos)*fLength 重缩放。细节弯曲: 频率四元组 (1.975,0.793,0.375,0.193)；vWaves=(frac((t+phase)*f)*2-1)*fSpeed*fDetailFreq 经 SmoothTriangleWave；vWavesSum=vWaves.xz+vWaves.yw；相位 fObjPhase=dot(worldPos.xyz,1) （世界坐标入相位→每株不同步）。CRYENGINE 顶点色 R=叶片边缘刚度 G=每叶相位变化 B=叶片整体刚度 A=预计算 AO（原记成“B=叶片上下”，与原文不符，已按 Ch.16 Figure 16-2 更正）

items.name: 空气透视 C_final=lerp(C,C_horizon,d/dmax)
items.note: 治 L3 dL 长期 FAIL
items.source: 空气透视参与介质形式：pixel = L_surface*T + L_air；T=exp(-tau)，tau=β·∫density(h)ds，density(h)=0.55·exp(-h/8000)+0.45·exp(-h/1500)（Rayleigh 分子层 + 气溶胶层）。T→0 时地表色收敛于同一视线天空色。metabunk Sitrec Atmospheric Aerial Perspective

items.name: action.beat_timeline：无多段动作时间线（0-3/3-6/6-9/9-12）
items.src: ADAPT《The Agent Development and Prototyping Testbed》(Shoulson, Marshak, Kapadia, Badler; IEEE TVCG 2013, Rutgers)——body capability 由 choreographer 产出，各自持有 skeleton 私有副本后经 blend node 合成，新增能力只需接入 pose dataflow graph；PBT scheduler 以 30 ticks/s 驱动。时间线分段与同步另参 SAIBA/BML《SmartBody: Behavior Realization for Embodied Conversational Agents》(Thiebaux et al., AAMAS 2008, USC ICT)——behavior & schedule manager 产出分层 motion controller 调度表
items.search_hint: ADAPT capability function animation timeline scheduler; Behavior Markup Language BML scheduling
items.note: ADAPT(Rutgers)能力函数+blend node；三相位prep-stroke-relax；crossfade各占半程恒为1；全局里程相位链；缺能力抛CapabilityError带search_hint
items.verify: 多段动作串成 12s，段边界无跳变
